args: Analyze the root cause and best minimal fix for CursivePosFormat1::subset in harfbuzz/src/OT/Layout/GPOS/CursivePosFormat1.hh when a coverage glyph passes glyphset_gsub filtering but has no entry in plan->glyph_map. Compare filtering on glyph_map membership before mapping versus checking HB_MAP_VALUE_INVALID after mapping, and identify analogous safe subsetting patterns elsewhere in HarfBuzz.

The provided ASan report shows CursivePosFormat1::subset maps each retained pair with c->plan->glyph_map[p.first], marks the mapped iterator HB_SORTED, then CoverageFormat2_4 serialization receives UINT_MAX as its first glyph and writes through rangeRecord.arrayZ[UINT_MAX]. The crafted font apparently creates inconsistency between glyphset_gsub and glyph_map. We need edit only C/C++ under harfbuzz, preserve intended records and sortedness, and fix the caller root cause rather than merely special-case the PoC.
